literal_meaning: চরা (চলমান বা ভ্রাম্যমাণ) + চর (চলমান বা ভ্রাম্যমাণ); চলমান জগতের উল্লেখ
figurative_meaning_en: The world or universe; the entire creation or cosmos
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই চরাচরে শান্তি প্রতিষ্ঠা করা কঠিন।
example_sentences_in_english: The entire creation is illuminated by your grace.
Establishing peace in this whole world is difficult.
history: Derived from Sanskrit 'charāchara' referring to mobile and immobile aspects of creation in ancient texts; popularized in Bengali literature by poets like Kazi Nazrul Islam.
note: Often used in poetic or philosophical contexts to denote the totality of existence.
